mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and depress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.25 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflation expectations, which triggers monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases when INDPRO < 104.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, reducing equity risk appetite and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 470 billion dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflationary pressure and leads to higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases when RSAFS > 470000.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in payroll employment signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and depress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.7 and PAYEMS > 145000.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 16800 billion dollars signals strong economic growth, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16800.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
